text: I don't know. My training data ends in June 2026, so I have no record of Bitcoin's price on August 14, 2026, and I don't have tools here to look it up. CoinMarketCap, CoinGecko, or an exchange's historical data page will have the daily close. Note that crypto trades 24/7, so "closing price" usually means the 00:00 UTC daily close, and figures can differ slightly between sources.
